item.title: EU B2B Compliance & AI-Readiness Auditor (thorlan04/eu-b2b-compliance-ai-auditor)
item.description: Enterprise-grade autonomous auditor built for European B2B supplier onboarding, KYB/KYC due diligence, and lead qualification. Unlike single-purpose registry tools or broken scrapers under maintenance, EU B2B Compliance & AI Auditor combines official French SIREN/SIRET checksum and registry verification, European Commission VIES intra-community VAT validation, live website GDPR compliance auditing (privacy policy, cookie consent CMP, DPO disclosure), European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025 / WCAG 2.1 AA) compliance checks, and an AI-Readiness score (llms.txt, Schema.org JSON-LD) in a single pay-per-event call.

item.title: Shopify Fast Catalog & Products JSON Monitor (thorlan04/shopify-fast-catalog-products-json)
item.description: Engineered for high-frequency e-commerce intelligence without the cost of residential proxies or headless browsers. Directly queries and paginates Shopify public `/products.json` and `/collections/*.json` endpoints to extract complete product catalogs, variant IDs, live stock availability, compare-at prices, SKUs, barcodes, tags, and high-resolution image URLs in seconds. Plugs directly into Claude Desktop, Cursor, n8n, Make.com, and RAG vector stores.

item.title: Apify B2B Autopilot Pack (thorlan04/apify-b2b-autopilot-pack)
item.description: The Swiss Army knife for AI engineers and B2B automation architects. Combines 4 critical capabilities into one cloud Actor and MCP server: (1) Boilerplate-free Web-to-Markdown extraction optimized for LLM context windows and RAG embeddings, (2) Automated `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` manifest generation for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), (3) EU B2B legal/GDPR/EAA compliance scanning, and (4) High-speed Shopify catalog intelligence.
